title: Three Years and One Short Bond
subtitle: 经济消费 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 经济消费（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·经济与消费）
meta: 主题语境：经济消费（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·经济与消费）　|　核心词汇：investment　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 investment 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 2003 the adviser ① made the investment that no client in the office would have recorded, and he said the making was the whole of the year. The ② investment, meaning the fund itself and not the bond, ran three years and stayed unrecorded in the book; an investment, he said, is the only thing in an office that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ investment in that office had the same short bond beside it, and the ④ investment at the far window, meaning the share they kept for the children to keep and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. An investment, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the adviser said the recording is the part that fills three years.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the investment was the whole of the matter, meaning the return and not the fund. The ⑥ investment, meaning the return and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; investment, he said, is either something you make or the only word that means both a fund and a return. He said the return is the part they remember.

By 2008 the ⑦ investment had become a line in a statement, and the statement had become an argument about the short bond. The ⑧ investment of the whole thing, the adviser wrote in June, was one office and three years of recording; investment, he said, is either the share at the far window or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ investment I remember is the fund recorded in the statement, which closed in 2010 and is still recorded as the quietest in the office. An ⑩ investment, my mother said in 2012, is the only fund that improves by being recorded; every investment, she said, is a return that has agreed to look like a fund. She said the return was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 投资；投入（指事务所里每一笔旁边的那一笔）
B. n. 投资；投入（指那笔资金本身，与债券相对）
C. 固定搭配：make the investment 进行这笔投资
D. n. 投资；投入（指留给孩子们存着的一份那一笔）
E. n. 投资之事（抽象总称，指一处事务所的投资之事）
F. n. 投资；投入（指结单里写到、被记下的的那一笔）
G. n. 回报、收益（指一件事里人人都投却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 收益（抽象总称，指人人都投却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: made the investment that no client in the office would have recorded
The investment, meaning the fund itself and not the bond
the investment at the far window
the investment was the whole of the matter
the investment had become a line in a statement
The investment of the whole thing
An investment, my mother said in 2012

answers.why: make the investment 意为“进行这笔投资”，2003 年那位顾问把事务所里没有一位客户肯记录的一笔投资做了一遍。
investment 意为“投资；投入”，指那笔资金本身而不是债券，它经过了三个年而在簿子上没有被记录。
investment 意为“投资；投入”，指事务所里每一笔旁边的那一笔，每一笔旁边都有同一张薄薄的债券。
investment 意为“投资；投入”，指最远那扇窗边留给孩子们存着的一份那一笔，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
investment 意为“回报、收益”，指一件事里人人都投却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这份回报就是那件事的全部。
investment 意为“收益”，指人人都投却无人提起的那样东西而不是那笔资金，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
investment 意为“投资；投入”，指结单里写到、被记下的的那一笔，到 2008 年这一笔成了结单里的一行。
investment 意为“投资之事”，顾问六月写道，整件事的投资之事是一处事务所和三个年的记录。
investment 意为“投资；投入”，我记得的是结单里记录过的那一笔，2010 年回本了，至今仍被说成事务所里最安静的一笔。
investment 为抽象总称，母亲 2012 年说，投资是唯一会因为被好好记录而变得更好的资金。
